description: At-a-glance overall condition label (PERS-04). Averages contributing conditions, inverting NEGATIVE stats, and shows a colour-coded Condition label. Presentation only.
Immediate physical capacity. Starts equal to Base HP and is capped by it. Counts toward Health as a percent of Base HP. Death at 0 or below (PERS-07).
Agent's maximum HP, rolled between 40 and 120 when an agent or analyst is created (PERS-10), similar to the player.
Injury modifies other vital tick rates; 70 or higher incapacitates
90 through 100 means collapse unconsciousness and forced off duty
Static per-agent decay rate; player sees warnings not percentage
90 or higher forces off duty and increases cult or defection risk
Derived from assignments; deployment is separate state
Can change through care neglect stress and department decisions
